findings.evidence: roadmap README.md:519-529 states `ψ_K(x)/x → 1` as a corollary of 12.2 consumed by 12.4; README.md:611-615 says the Layer-14 denominator "comes from 12.2". The PR itself needs the fact a second time in another file and cannot cite it.
findings.fix: Drop `private`, move it into the `public section` with a docstring, and list it under `## Main results`; then Layer 14 can consume it directly.
findings.issue: `primePsi_univ_asymptotic` is `private`, but it is the standalone roadmap result `ψ_K(x) = x + o(x)` (README 12.2, "Summing this over all of `Gal(F/K)` ... gives `ψ_K(x)/x → 1`"), which Layer 14 names as the source of the density denominator. findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Conj.lean:230 `theorem mk_bijective` is stated under `variable [CommMonoid α]` (line 223); the only `CommMonoid (L ≃ₐ[K] L)` available is the scoped `instance (priority := 50) … CommMonoid M` of mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/IsCommutative.lean:84, whose docstring warns it is scoped "so as to avoid deleterious effects to type class synthesis".
findings.fix: Bind it once with an explicit ascription against the ambient instance and use that: `have hmk : Function.Bijective (ConjClasses.mk : (L ≃ₐ[K] L) → ConjClasses (L ≃ₐ[K] L)) := open scoped IsMulCommutative in ConjClasses.mk_bijective`, with a comment noting the instance-path defeq; then `rw [… Fintype.sum_bijective _ hmk …]`.
findings.issue: `ConjClasses.mk_bijective` is elaborated under the scoped `CommMonoid`, so the `ConjClasses (L ≃ₐ[K] L)` in its type is built from `CommMonoid.toMonoid (IsMulCommutative.instCommMonoid …)` while the goal's is built from the ambient `AlgEquiv.aut` path; the `rw`/`Fintype.sum_bijective` match only by unfolding instance projections, and neither comment says so. Same reliance at line 174.

summary: Two reusable facts the PR proves — the roadmap's `ψ_K(x) = x + o(x)` (12.2) and the all-prime counting denominator `π_K(x)/(x/log x) → 1` (Layer 14) — are hidden as a `private` lemma and an inline `have`, forcing a detour that re-derives one from the other. The two `ConjClasses.mk_bijective` rewrites also rely on undocumented defeq across the scoped `CommMonoid` instance.
